meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: Claude 能操控浏览器完成网页操作：打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据，还能在多次操作之间保留页面状态，分步完成复杂任务。
howto.when: 当你说“打开某网址”“点击某个元素”“填写表单”等，或要求截图、抓取数据、测试网页时触发。

say.note: 会打开网页并保存截图

say.text: 在搜索框输入“旅行”并点击搜索按钮
say.note: 会自动操作表单和点击

say.text: 抓取这个页面上的所有新闻标题
say.note: 会提取页面数据并返回结果

howto.what_en: Claude can control a browser to visit pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and keep page state between steps for multi-step tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to visit a URL, click an element, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape data, or test a webpage.

say_en.text: Open example.com and screenshot the homepage
say_en.note: Opens the page and saves a screenshot

say_en.text: Type 'travel' in the search box and click search
Scrape all news headlines from this page
say_en.note: Extracts page data and returns results
